name: Bike rides by hour
description: The original playground example — 12-row CSV, bar chart of hourly rides.

name: Quarterly revenue
description: Eight quarters of revenue + prior-year comparison, as a bar chart.

name: Conversion funnel (animated)
description: Visit → Sign-up → Activate → Subscribe → Renew. Bars cascade in top-to-bottom with conversion-% labels.

name: Daily active users
description: 30-day DAU growth — line + point marks layered on the same encoding.

name: Top-selling products
description: Eight products ranked by units sold, ordinal x-axis bar chart.

name: API error rate by hour
description: Diurnal error rate pattern — line + area layered together.

name: A/B test result
description: Four-variant sign-up-conversion comparison, ordinal bars.

name: Cohort retention heatmap
description: 8 monthly cohorts × 8 weeks of retention %, the canonical SaaS health view.

name: Revenue treemap (Q3 by product)
description: Hierarchical $24.5M Q3 breakdown — Cloud, Pro Tools, Edge — sized by revenue share.

name: CAC vs LTV scatter
description: Acquisition-channel efficiency: x = CAC, y = LTV, bubble size = monthly signups.

name: API latency boxplot
description: Per-endpoint latency distribution — quartiles, whiskers, outliers via Tukey 1.5×IQR.

name: Sales calendar heatmap
description: Orders by day-of-week × hour-of-day — the GitHub-contributions style activity map.

name: Marketing spend sunburst
description: $3.9M annual budget — Performance, Brand, Lifecycle — two labeled rings with name + $-value per channel.

name: Revenue donut (polar bar)
description: Eng / Sales / Marketing revenue split — bar mark + polar coordinates = donut.

name: KPI radar (6-axis scorecard)
description: Six-axis product scorecard — Performance, Reliability, Security, Cost, UX, Velocity — with grid rings, spokes, value dots, and per-axis labels.

name: Engineering org graph
description: 10-node reporting tree color-coded by group (Executive, Platform, Product), with dashed cross-team collaboration edges.

name: Customer density contour
description: Two activity clusters on a 40×28 grid — marching-squares isolines at 5 thresholds.

name: US sales by region (choropleth)
description: Five Census-style US regions colored by Q3 sales — `geo-region` mark with hand-crafted GeoJSON and an equirectangular projection.

name: Bar chart race (animated)
description: Top products by revenue across 6 years — SMIL race animation, bar widths interpolate frame-by-frame.

name: Wealth & health of nations
description: Gapminder-style bubble chart — x=GDP/capita, y=life expectancy, bubble area=population, color=continent (2023 snapshot).

name: Revenue stacked area
description: Monthly revenue by 4 customer segments — Enterprise, Mid-market, Startup, Self-serve — each band a distinct color.

name: Moving average (raw + 14-day MA)
description: 60 days of noisy daily signups (light blue) overlaid with a 14-day trailing moving average (orange).

name: Index chart — 5 tech stocks
description: 24 months of geometric-walk prices, every series rebased to 100 on day 1 — the canonical relative-return view.

name: Streamgraph (centered stacked area)
description: Same 4-segment revenue data as the stacked-area example, drawn with a centered baseline so each band's thickness is what your eye reads.

name: Circle packing — revenue hierarchy
description: Three product-line bubbles, each surrounded by its child products. Inner radius scales with √revenue so visual size tracks impact.

name: Composite: bars + trend + outliers
description: Monthly revenue bars in accent blue, 3-month moving average overlay in orange, outliers (>1.6σ) called out in red with a launch annotation.

name: Revenue pie (arc mark)
description: Eng / Sales / Marketing split — first-class `mark: "arc"` (no manual polar setup needed). Slice angle proportional to share.

name: Slopegraph — 2023 vs 2024
description: Six KPIs year-over-year. Lines connect each metric's two periods; the eye picks up direction + magnitude of change in one glance.

name: Step line — plan tier over time
description: Customer plan tier across 12 months. `interpolate: "step"` keeps the value flat between samples, vertical at the change.

name: Tenure beeswarm — by team
description: 12 employees × 4 teams. Each dot is one person; the `beeswarm` mark packs them horizontally inside each band so density shows without losing individual points.

name: Acquisition sankey
description: 3 acquisition channels → trial / freemium → paid + expanded, with churn at every step. First-class `mark: "sankey"`: longest-path layering + barycenter sort + bezier links sized by flow.

name: Ridgeline plot — API latency distribution
description: Six API endpoints stacked vertically, each ridge a smoothed density-like profile of its latency distribution. Slower endpoints have a visible right tail.

name: Dot plot — feature usage by role
description: 5 roles × 12 users each — one dot per user. Veterans dark, newer light; per-row jitter keeps overlaps readable.

name: Diverging bar — NPS responses
description: 9 product features, Detractors stretching left in red and Promoters stretching right in green from the 0 line. Net column on the right.

name: Horizontal stacked bar — population by age
description: 6 countries normalized to 100% so each age-bracket share reads directly. Labels inline when the slice is wide enough.

name: Year calendar — daily activity heatmap
description: 53 weeks × 7 days, GitHub-contribution style. Two vacation gaps mid-year visible as cooler vertical strips.

name: Parallel coordinates — product comparison
description: 5 products plotted across 6 vertical axes (Performance, Cost, UX, Security, Reliability, Revenue). Correlations and tradeoffs read directly.

name: Difference chart — actual vs target
description: Two-line plot with the gap between actual and target shaded green (beats) or red (misses) per month-segment.

name: Sine wave — y = sin(x)
description: Two full periods of the canonical wave. Function data shape, 200 samples.

name: Lissajous curve
description: Parametric (sin(3t), cos(2t)) — the figure that traces both axes in one stroke.

name: Hypotrochoid rosette
description: Spirograph-style rosette — the curve a point on a small circle traces inside a larger one.

name: Golden curlicue
description: Davis-Knuth-Pickover curlicue at the golden-ratio rotation step.

name: Cubic Bezier — de Casteljau
description: Cubic Bezier curve with the de Casteljau construction overlay at t=0.5.

name: Gravitational lensing
description: A geodesic in Schwarzschild geometry — light bending around a black hole.

name: Predator-prey orbit
description: Lotka-Volterra trajectory — the canonical limit cycle of ecology.

name: Heartbeat (FitzHugh-Nagumo)
description: Relaxation oscillator producing the spike-and-recover rhythm of a resting heart.

name: Leopard spots (Gray-Scott)
description: Reaction-diffusion at F=k=0.062 — the leopard-spots regime of the Gray-Scott PDE.

name: Sunflower phyllotaxis
description: Vogel's 1979 model — 200 seeds at radius √n, angle n·137.5° (the golden angle).

name: DNA double helix
description: Two phosphate strands winding at 10 base pairs per turn, against a starfield.

name: Heart + circulation (animated)
description: Anatomical heart with great vessels and lungs. Pulse-animated at 67 bpm via SMIL.

name: Bioluminescent jellyfish
description: Aurelia aurita — translucent bell, sine-modulated tentacles, plankton dots.

name: 4-6-2 Pacific steam locomotive
description: Side elevation: boiler, smokebox, brass side rod, four spoked driving wheels.

name: Dutch tower windmill (animated)
description: Stone tower, 4 rotating sails on rotate-loop, morning sky with sun + clouds.

name: Suspension bridge
description: Golden Gate-style: art-deco towers, parabolic cable, 30 suspenders.

name: Gothic cathedral (Notre-Dame)
description: West facade: twin towers, central spire, rose-window tracery, triple portal.

name: Doric Greek temple
description: Six fluted columns with entasis, triglyph frieze, pediment with tympanum.

name: Art Deco skyscraper at dusk
description: 4-tier Empire State-style setback massing, lit windows, pulsing antenna light.

name: Solar system orrery (animated)
description: Six planets, six rotate-loop animations scaled by real orbital years.

name: Lorenz attractor (3D)
description: The canonical chaos system unfolding in 3D. The path traces itself frame-by-frame; the whole scene slowly rotates so the strange attractor reads from every angle.

name: DNA double helix (3D)
description: Two phosphate strands winding 4 turns around a central axis with 56 base-pair rungs between them. Slow rotation reveals the helical geometry.

name: Planetary gears (3D)
description: Sun gear with 4 planet gears meshing around it. Rotation speeds are properly geared (planet spins at sun_teeth/planet_teeth × sun rate).

name: Particle galaxy (3D)
description: 8,000 GPU-rendered particles in a 3-arm spiral. Each particle orbits at a radius-dependent rate (Kepler-ish), color shifts with distance from center.

name: Torus knot (3D)
description: (3, 4) torus knot — a parametric mathematical surface with a translucent wireframe overlay. Slowly rotates on two axes so the topology reads from any angle.

name: Truss bridge (3D)
description: Parametric Warren-truss bridge with 8 bays, cross-bracing between the two trusses, and a deck slab. Camera orbits slowly to inspect from every side.

name: Why did rides spike at 8am?
description: Static rendering of what glyph_whyboard returns: a root + three diagnostic branches (anomaly, decompose, forecast), each leaf a chained DataHandle. Mirrors the homepage example.
